request.name: Rotate root and/or intermediate certificates

description.content:
Rotate root and/or intermediate certificates for the compute cluster.
Three modes are supported:
1. Empty body (no keep_root) - regenerate all certificates (root + intermediate + leaf).
2. Empty body with keep_root=true - keep root, regenerate intermediate + leaf.
3. Provide all 3 certificate fields in body - use provided certs, generate leaf.

query.description: If true, keep the existing root certificate and only regenerate intermediate and leaf certificates
